Top code links spot-verified live by the parent: GRH mirror repo (public, created 2026-11-20, commit 7cbf7a0c, lean-toolchain present, 175,187 files), Euler arXiv:2611.26772 abs page (submitted Nov 19, ancillary terminal_smoothness files), Navier-Stokes repo (public, created 2026-11-20, commit ad53419, certificate NOT in repo per README), Turan five-cycle Hexagon page (2611.00770v1, Nov 21, Zenodo 23743819, toolchain v4.32.2, 692 native_decide facts), Zarankiewicz Hexagon page (2611.00319v1, Nov 16, archive release v1 commit 10385847). Coverage caveats: math.NT keyword-searched only, not fully enumerated; Nov 21-22 weekend submissions and Nov 23 mail may be incompletely indexed; Hexagon Nov 19-23 deposits beyond those found may exist (Kruer-group 35-deposit cascade of Lean-checked Erdos-problem results 2611.00746-00787, 2611.00760, 2611.00739, 2611.00702/00703/00704, 2611.00730, 2611.00788, 2611.00789, 2611.00699, 2611.00700/00701, 2611.00557, 2611.00580 not individually assessed); Nov 22-23 deposits unswept (search-index lag); gitlab.com policy-blocked, Girsanov Lean repo still unresolvable. Near-misses failing public inputs: 2611.05514 (re-checked, still no code), 2611.16043 (Girsanov-Wasserstein, GitLab ref unresolvable), 2611.19610 (elite primes, Lean claimed, no repo/ancillary), 2611.20146 (evacuation Farkas certificates, no files), 2611.23622 (2x2 matmul, no code), 2611.18148 (pulsed-field ablation, no code link), 2611.01257 (DFT bound, Lean claimed, no code location), Hexagon 2611.00729v1 (peaceable queens a(19)=52, a(20)=58, repo URL unlocated), Hexagon 2611.00644v1 (AKLT gap, Lean source explicitly not included), Hexagon 2611.00721v1 / 2611.00716v1 (pure theory), Hexagon 2611.00769v1 (Euler dense blow-up data, no code/Lean), Masullo GRH manuscript (no public code/data), Anthropic Fable 5.2 FLT re-proof (Lean code still unreleased), 2611.26272 (Paper2Lean tool paper, not a single claim), 2611.17618 (Lean-PEP tool paper). Out-of-window flags: Hexagon 2611.00333 (exact LRX diameter of S_n, Lean repo + Palomar PALOMAR-2026-11-10-000010, published Nov 11-12, missed by the 2026-11-16 run), Hexagon 2611.00349 (Caceres Lambda <= 0.174, Nov 13, weaker than audited 0.1486), 2611.10961 (Grothendieck/Korenblum constants, Nov 7, code location unverified), hubbard-spectral-moments-lean (arXiv:2611.19929, cond-mat, repo stated in paper but not live-verified this run).
